guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Atlanta this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: Garden Lights, Holiday Nights
items.blurb: The Garden's 16th light show, with the Tunnel of Light and a giant dragon.
items.blurbEs: El 16.º espectáculo de luces del jardín, con el Túnel de Luz y un dragón gigante.

items.name: Lights of Life
items.dates: Nov 26 – Dec 31; sunset to 9 PM (10 PM Fri–Sat)
items.blurb: A drive-through of more than a million lights with walk-around photo spots.
items.blurbEs: Un recorrido en auto con más de un millón de luces y lugares para fotos.

items.name: Stone Mountain Christmas
items.addr: 1000 Robert E Lee Blvd, Stone Mountain, GA 30083
items.blurb: Over two million lights, holiday shows and park attractions.
items.blurbEs: Más de dos millones de luces, espectáculos navideños y atracciones del parque.

items.name: Lights on the Loop
items.blurb: A mile-long light display along the trail, with live music on select nights.
items.blurbEs: Una milla de luces a lo largo del sendero, con música en vivo algunas noches.

items.name: Magical Nights of Lights
items.blurb: A classic drive-through light show at the lakeside resort.
items.blurbEs: Un clásico recorrido en auto de luces en el resort junto al lago.

guides.title: Holiday markets
guides.intro: Where to shop local for the holidays in Atlanta: Christmas markets, makers fairs and holiday villages running this season.

items.name: Christkindl Market Lawrenceville
items.blurb: An Old World-style market with handmade goods, food and drinks.
items.blurbEs: Un mercado al estilo europeo con productos artesanales, comida y bebidas.

items.name: Holiday Spirit at Oakland Cemetery
items.blurb: A Victorian-style holiday market with live music and photos with Santa.
items.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño de estilo victoriano con música en vivo y fotos con Santa.

items.name: Brookhaven Holiday Bazaar
items.dates: Sat Dec 5, 9 AM–noon; Sun Dec 6, 11 AM–2 PM
items.blurb: 20+ local vendors selling artisan goods and gifts.
items.blurbEs: Más de 20 vendedores locales con productos artesanales y regalos.
